description.cs: Prvek občanské vybavenosti v okolí nemovitosti. Oddělen od `Location`, protože jde o popisnou informaci, ne o prostorovou identifikaci.
description.en: An amenity in the surroundings of the property. Kept separate from `Location`, because it is descriptive information, not spatial identification.
Distance from the property in metres (`MTR`).

description.cs: Producent smí vedle `Place` uvést konkrétnější typ schema.org (např. `SubwayStation`, `Preschool`, `Park`).
description.en: Producers may add a more specific schema.org type (e.g. `SubwayStation`, `Preschool`, `Park`) next to `Place`.
